text.en:
Immigration Act
(Chapter 133)
Immigration Officers
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 3(1) of the Immigration Act, the Minister for Home Affairs has appointed all officers in the Singapore Immigration & Registration Senior Service and the Singapore Immigration & Registration Junior Service to be immigration officers for the purpose of carrying out the provisions of the Act, with effect from 1st April 1998.
